news.headline: HDFC Bank vs ICICI Bank: One has the growth, the other has the valuation edge. Which stock to buy?
news.summary: ICICI Bank has outperformed HDFC Bank in 2026, supported by stronger deposits, loan growth and profitability. While ICICI commands a valuation premium, HDFC’s 28% stock decline has created a potential recovery opportunity. Brokerages see scope for HDFC’s margins to improve, but narrowing the growth and funding gap remains key.

news.headline: PSU bank stocks soar up to 8%, but HDFC, Axis and other private lenders fall up to 5% after Q2 results. Why the sharp divide?
news.summary: PSU bank stocks surged up to 8% on Monday, led by Punjab National Bank after its Q2FY27 earnings beat estimates. In contrast, private lenders such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank fell up to 5% despite reporting profit growth. The Nifty PSU Bank index gained over 2%, while its private-sector counterpart declined.

news.headline: HDFC Bank shares fall 2% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, Motilal Oswal analysts saying?
news.summary: HDFC Bank shares fell up to 2% after the lender reported a 4.6% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 19,510 crore. Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, Systematix and Emkay retained positive ratings, citing margin recovery potential and leadership transition.

news.headline: ICICI Bank share price target after Q2 results: What are Jefferies, other analysts saying?
news.summary: ICICI Bank Share Price: ICICI Bank shares rose after Q2FY27 net profit increased 20.1% year-on-year to Rs 14,843 crore, while net interest income grew 17.7% to Rs 25,339 crore. Jefferies maintained its ‘Buy’ rating with a target price of Rs 1,750, implying 25% upside, citing improving margins and expectations of 16% core profit CAGR over FY26-29.

news.headline: India bonds rise after flat open as sharp drop in US yields spurs value buying
news.summary: The Indian government bond market saw a positive turnaround as US Treasury yields declined, prompting significant value purchases. The benchmark 6.94% bond maturing in 2036 observed a yield of 7.3551% in morning trading. Concurrently, oil prices dipped, fueled by expectations of improved supply following lifted sanctions on Russia. With India's consumer inflation rising to 5.54%, the Reserve Bank of India may respond with tighter financial conditions amidst ongoing capital outflows.

news.headline: Stock Market Down: Bulls lose ground! Sensex sinks nearly 900 points, Nifty ends below 22,900; 5 key triggers behind Rs 5 lakh crore selloff
news.summary: Why is Market Down Today: The Indian stock market took a hit on Monday after a considerable rise the previous week. Both Sensex and Nifty struggled, with Axis Bank and HDFC Bank suffering significant losses. However, firms like SBI and UltraTech Cement managed to post gains. The PSU Bank index rose, providing a stark contrast to the declining private banking sector.

news.headline: Axis Bank shares fall over 4% despite 38% YoY jump in Q2 net profit. Why brokerages are revising target prices
news.summary: Axis Bank reported a 38% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 7,003 crore in Q2 FY27, while net interest income rose 12%. Jefferies retained its Buy rating, while Centrum Broking and Dolat Capital lowered their target prices.

news.headline: IDBI Bank shares in focus as Q2 net profit falls 39%; NII tanks nearly 50% YoY
news.summary: IDBI Bank reported a 39% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit, partly due to a one-off gain in the previous year. Despite this, underlying profitability, margins, asset quality, deposits and advances showed improvement. Meanwhile, Fairfax Financial’s proposed 60.72% stake acquisition marks a major milestone in the bank’s privatisation.

news.headline: India bonds give up day's gains as oil price spike adds to rate hike fears
news.summary: Indian government bonds ended lower as inflation concerns increased due to rising crude oil prices. The benchmark 10-year bond yield has been rising for nine consecutive weeks, causing worries about further rate hikes. Economists predict consumer inflation might exceed the upper tolerance band of the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, the Reserve Bank has taken measures to curb currency speculation and stabilize the financial market.

news.headline: Muhurat Trading 2026: BSE, NSE announce date and timings of special session. Check details
news.summary: BSE and NSE has announced the schedule for Diwali Muhurat Trading 2026, set for Sunday, November 8, on the occasion of Laxmi Pujan. The special session will run from 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm, with separate timings for pre-open trading, block deals, IPOs, call auctions and closing procedures.

news.headline: HFCL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 448% YoY to Rs 394 crore; stock hits 5% upper circuit
news.summary: HFCL reported a 448% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 394 crore, compared with Rs 71.92 crore a year ago. Revenue surged 144% to Rs 2,542 crore, while EBITDA rose 224% to Rs 658 crore. EBITDA margin expanded 640 basis points to 25.89%. The optical fibre and AI beneficiary’s stock hit the 5% upper circuit at Rs 268.70 on the BSE and has gained nearly 300% so far this year.

news.headline: PNB shares jump 8% after Q2 results beat estimates; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others raise target prices
news.summary: Punjab National Bank shares rose sharply on Monday after the lender reported a 13% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 5,532 crore. Stronger net interest income and improving asset quality prompted bullish brokerage calls, with Jefferies, Motilal Oswal and JM Financial setting target prices of Rs 140 apiece.

news.headline: Yes Bank shares rise as Q2 profit beats estimates, but AT1 bond verdict hit pegged at Rs 5,217 crore. What lies ahead?
news.summary: Yes Bank shares rose after falling 17% over two sessions, following a 65% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,080 crore. However, the lender cautioned that the reported earnings exclude the potential impact of the Supreme Court’s AT1 bond ruling.

news.headline: Urban Company shares slide 7% as Q2 net loss triples YoY on InstaHelp burn. Should you buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: Urban Company shares fell sharply on Monday after its Q2FY27 net loss more than tripled YoY to Rs 182 crore, driven by investments in InstaHelp. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore. Motilal Oswal maintained a Neutral rating but cut its target price to Rs 165, citing profitability concerns and balanced risk-reward.

news.headline: Global Markets: French markets tumble as riots add to political crisis
news.summary: Protests across France have led to significant declines in the country's financial markets and stocks. French government officials requested local authorities to consider imposing curfews amid the unrest. The rise in bond yields suggests increasing investor concern over France's budgetary challenges and economic outlook. Major French banks have experienced stock declines, reflecting the heightened risk of insuring French debt.
